# Cricket Arena
> Pakistan Cricket Tactical Analytics, Match Breakdowns & PCB Intelligence

Authoritative independent cricket publication covering Pakistan white-ball strategy, player biomechanics, death-overs execution, PSL analytics, and ICC Champions Trophy preparation in English & Urdu.

## Canonical Website
- Website: https://cricket-arena.github.io
- Category Coverage: اردو اینالیٹکس (Urdu), Match Analysis, Player Focus, Tactics & Speed, Tournament Dossier, Analytics
- Data Format: JSON, HTML5, Structured Schema.org NewsArticle
